scientific.integrity: The first source-form LAMB step on an isotropic quadratic is reduced to a normalized direction with a coordinatewise monotone saturation map. A sharp co-monotone cosine inequality yields the exact worst objective factor and learning-rate boundary.
limitations: First step from zero moment states only.
Isotropic positive quadratic, zero weight decay, and source scaling choice phi(z)=z.
Trust-ratio clipping, bounded scaling, and later moment history are outside the theorem.
Worst-case layer-state statement rather than a typical-case neural-network claim.

title: LAMB has a sharp dimension-dependent first-step descent threshold
